title: CC-Demo club management system: Finance module (v07, final version)

pm.problem: NSRCC accounts for the money of five operational modules (Membership, Golf, Events, Facilities and Resorts) in a legacy environment where fees, charges, payments and refunds are re-keyed into Finance, receivables, deferred revenue and entrance-fee amortisation are worked in spreadsheets, GIRO results, cheques and cashier counts are reconciled by hand, refunds and corrections have no consistent maker-checker trail, and the Yonyou ERP is fed by manual batches. The To-Be design (FIN-OPS, partly Interim Design and TBC) gives one intake register for every module's financial events, posting sets with Output GST from approved mappings, member receivables and payments with allocation, standing orders and bank results, spending credit, refunds prepared and approved by two people, deferred revenue and recognition, amortisation, reconciliation and the cashier close, adjustments, financial periods, Yonyou staging runs, exceptions, dunning and General AR. Finance is built here as the final module, and every Finance stub in the other modules is replaced by these financial events.

users.goal: Validate the intake, post, record and allocate payments, run GIRO and bank results, prepare refunds, adjustments and invoices, recognise revenue, amortise, reconcile and close cashier sessions, stage Yonyou runs, work exceptions and dunning
Approve refunds, configuration changes, adjustments, invoices and notes; override credit limits; close and reopen periods
Confirm a Membership fee as paid (a FIN-OPS Payment) or record a failed payment
See the FIN-OPS balance and available credit, and act on dunning escalations through the Suspension request

users.role: Module staff (Golf Operations, Events Team, Facilities Staff, Resort Front Desk)
users.goal: Take payments and raise charges and refunds that arrive in FIN-OPS as financial events
Read Finance and run the Finance reports; close the resort business day that recognises the night's stays

decision.question: Should we build Finance (FIN-OPS: event intake, postings with GST, receivables, payments and allocation, standing orders and bank results, spending credit, refunds, deferred revenue and entrance-fee amortisation, reconciliation and cashier close, adjustments, periods, Yonyou staging, exceptions, dunning, General AR and reports) as the one place every module's money is accounted for, completing the club system across all seven modules?

pm.scenarios:
Feature: CC-Demo Finance (v07)

Scenario: Validate queue sorts the day's events (Story-180, 181, 197, BR-133, 134)
  Given 13 received events from Membership, Golf, Events, Facilities, Resorts and the POS file
  When Finance Officer R. Tan runs Validate queue
  Then the valid events are Accepted and posted
  And the duplicate golf event and the unmatched POS line become exceptions with an owner
  And the resort event without a tax code is Returned to Resorts with its reason
  And each source module shows the FIN-OPS status of its event

Scenario: A posting set balances with Output GST (Story-182, BR-137, BR-138)
  Given an accepted golf charge of S$109.00 including GST
  When it is posted
  Then the set has a receivable leg, a revenue leg of S$100.00 and an Output GST leg of S$9.00
  And total debits equal total credits

Scenario: Payment allocation and receipt (Story-185, BR-141, BR-142, BR-170)
  Given Member B. Lim (LB10002) owes S$450 on bill BL-0412 (Oct) and S$750 (Sep)
  When R. Tan records S$1,500 cash naming BL-0412
  Then BL-0412 is paid first, then the September bill, and S$300 stays as unapplied credit
  And the receipt carries a PaymentNo PN-…
  When the receipt is reprinted
  Then the same PaymentNo is shown and the reprint is audited

Scenario: Refunds need two people (Story-189, 164, BR-150, BR-151)
  Given the resort refund RF-0001 approved by the Manager and a facility refund paid S$20 by card and S$15 by in-house credit
  When R. Tan prepares both and tries to approve one
  Then approval is refused for the preparer
  When C. Lau approves and R. Tan releases them
  Then the card part is refunded to the card and the S$15 is restored to the member account, never paid out as cash
  And the refund register shows each part with its source

Scenario: Night Audit recognises the night's stays (Story-190, 174, BR-152, BR-130)
  Given resort stays in-house on 27 Oct with deposits held as deferred revenue
  When the Manager closes the business day after a clean Night Audit
  Then the day goes to FIN-OPS as financial events
  And one night per stay is recognised as revenue with no second GST

Scenario: Posting runs stage clean lines only (Story-195, 196, BR-160, BR-161, BR-162)
  Given posted events of 28 Oct, one with an open exception
  When R. Tan runs the 13:00 posting
  Then batch PB-… stages every posting-ready line and leaves the excepted line out
  When the file export fails and is retried
  Then the same batch is exported, not regenerated
  When the Yonyou response is imported with one rejected line
  Then the other lines keep their ERP document numbers and the rejected line becomes an exception
  When the 21:00 posting runs
  Then only lines not staged before are taken

Scenario: Dunning escalates to Membership, never suspends (Story-198, 031, BR-164, BR-165)
  Given PA10023 overdue 125 days, WE10005 overdue 65 days and OO10015 in dispute
  When R. Tan evaluates dunning
  Then PA10023 is Escalated: the escalation shows on the Member 360 and the Membership dashboard with a link to the Suspension request, and the membership is unchanged
  And WE10005 pays part and drops to Reminder 1
  And OO10015 is put on hold with the reason Dispute
  And the reminders are in the Communications outbox

Scenario: Confirm payment records a FIN-OPS Payment (Story-202, 004, 030, BR-006)
  Given an approved application awaiting payment with its fee as a FIN-OPS receivable
  When the Approver clicks Mark payment failed
  Then a rejected attempt is recorded and the request stays Awaiting Payment
  When the Approver clicks Confirm payment
  Then a FIN-OPS Payment with a PaymentNo settles the receivable and the membership activates
successCriteria: No module money step without a FIN-OPS financial event, and no page showing a Finance stub reference (0 cases, BR-133, Story-202)
No posting set released with debits different from credits beyond S$0.01, or without an approved mapping (0 cases, BR-136, BR-138)
No refund, configuration change, adjustment, invoice, note or override approved by its maker (0 cases, BR-139, 150, 157, 166, 167)
No line staged with a blocking exception, and no batch regenerated on retry (0 cases, BR-160, BR-162)
No in-house credit paid out as cash, card or PayNow (0 cases, BR-151)
Every Finance page that uses an Interim Design or TBC rule shows the note (100 %, D-371); no "Coming in v0N" badge or planned card left anywhere (0)
Reviewers run the v07 scenarios and the kept v01 to v06 scenarios end to end with the scenario guide, each started from Module details (67 of 67)
businessRules: BR-001: When a membership is activated, then it gets a unique Membership ID of 2 initials + 5 digits
BR-002: When a Person already has an open application for the same membership type and purpose, then a new one is blocked
BR-003: When an application is assessed, then the applicant must meet the eligibility of the type (adult types ≥ 21, Junior 5–20, Corporate: Singapore-registered company)
BR-004: When a request is submitted for approval, then every mandatory document of its type must be attached
BR-005: When a request is decided, then only an Approver (or the Manager where routed) may decide, and never the person who submitted it
BR-006: When a fee applies to an approved request, then it completes only after Finance confirms payment; a failed payment leaves it Awaiting Payment
BR-007: When an application is saved, then a recruitment source is required, and referrer details are required when the source is Referral
BR-008: When a renewal, conversion or extension would take combined Associate + Ordinary duration over 30 years (absent periods excluded), then it is blocked
BR-009: When a renewal is requested, then it must come from the member and the membership must be Active (or Absent / Medical)
BR-010: When Full converts to Basic, then remaining months × 2; when Basic converts to Full, then remaining months ÷ 2, rounded down
BR-011: When a transfer is requested, then the type must be transferable (Corporate is not) and the recipient must meet the type's eligibility
BR-012: When an extension is requested, then it may not exceed 24 months; ≤ 12 months goes to an Approver, > 12 months to the Manager
BR-013: When a withdrawal completes, then Finance must have cleared the balance, no refund of the remaining term is made, and the status becomes Withdrawn
BR-014: When the expiry date passes with no approved renewal, then the status becomes Expired; an approved rejoin reactivates with the original Membership ID
BR-015: When a deceased case proposes a goodwill refund, then only the Manager may approve it, and only then is it sent to Finance
BR-016: When an absent period is requested, then it must be 3–24 months and must not overlap an approved absent period; the term is suspended for it
BR-017: When a medical period is requested, then it may not exceed 12 months, and the expiry date is not changed
BR-018: When a status change is requested, then it is allowed only if the transition matrix permits it; a membership has exactly one current status
BR-019: When the status is Active, then privileges and billing are on; Absent / Medical: privileges off, billing per policy; Suspended: privileges off, billing on; other statuses: both off
BR-020: When a supplementary membership is created, then its principal must be Active; when the principal ends, the supplementary ends too
BR-021: When a junior member reaches 21, then junior eligibility ends; nothing converts automatically
BR-022: When a corporate nominee is assigned, then active nominees may not exceed the type's limit; a new corporate membership needs the Administrator

BR-023: When credit is checked, then available credit = In-House Credit Limit − Finance outstanding balance; if the Finance balance is unavailable, the check is blocked; Spending Credit Granted never changes
BR-024: When a vehicle is registered, then the membership must be Active and have fewer than 4 active vehicles
BR-025: When a card is issued, then the membership must be Active; the digital card is primary; a replacement voids the previous card
BR-026: When a marketing campaign is sent, then persons who withheld marketing consent are excluded; service correspondence is not affected
BR-027: When an active member's profile is saved, then mandatory fields (name, ID, date of birth, mobile, email, address) must be filled
BR-028: When a configuration value is referenced by a record, then it can be made inactive but not deleted
BR-029: When a request is approved, then its fee is read from the fee configuration of the type and event; no fee is requested before approval
BR-030: When a referred application completes, then a referral reward is raised only if an active referral campaign exists

BR-031: When a user opens the report catalogue or runs, exports or defines a report, then only the reports and data scope their role's access rule allows are offered; audit and workflow-history reports are restricted further
BR-032: When a report is run, then every required parameter must be given and valid, and the output is limited to the selected criteria
BR-033: When a report run matches no records, then a valid no-data result is shown without error; a run never changes a source record
BR-034: When a generated report is exported, then only a report designated for export may be, as Excel or PDF, with exactly the rows and scope shown on screen
BR-035: When a user-defined report is saved, then it builds on an approved report, cannot widen the role's data scope, and gets a new version with an effective date; earlier runs keep their version

BR-036: When a tee-sheet period is prepared, then tee times are generated per course (Changi, Kranji), day type and session from the configuration, and 9-hole play is allowed only in the weekday 07:01 – 07:57 period, never on weekend or public-holiday mornings
BR-037: When a tee time is booked online, then the request must fall inside the booking window and at least 2 hours before tee-off; staff-assisted booking may go later
BR-038: When a golfer is booked, then they hold no other session that day (an active waitlist entry counts); a second same-day 18-hole round needs Golf Manager approval with a reason

BR-039: When a flight is booked, then it has at most 4 golfers and at least 2 on weekdays or 3 on weekends and public holidays; a single golfer joins an existing flight instead of opening an invalid solo flight
BR-040: When a golfer uses member privileges, then their membership or nominee status from MMS must be Active with golf privilege; a suspended member cannot book or play
BR-041: When a Basic Member books, then they play weekdays independently, and on weekends only in a flight whose main booker is an eligible Full Member

BR-042: When guests are added, then the introducer is at least 18 and plays in the same flight, brings at most 3 guests, each guest holds a recognised handicap, and no guest plays at Changi on Saturday afternoon without approval

BR-043: When eligibility is checked, then on weekends and public holidays male HI ≤ 24.4 and female HI ≤ 36.4 play at any time; male 24.5 – 36.4, female 36.5 – 40.4 and NSRCC PC holders play weekdays or from 16:30; an external PC does not count

BR-044: When capacity is released, then it is offered first to the earliest waitlist entry whose party fits, held for 15 minutes; on decline or expiry the next entry gets it, and only then does it return to general availability

BR-045: When a booking is amended, then a player substitution carries the substitution fee, and a course change is allowed only with equivalent capacity at the other course and carries the course-change fee
BR-046: When a booking is cancelled with less than 72 hours' notice, then the late-cancellation charge (based on the course green fee) is raised on the booking member

BR-047: When an amendment, cancellation, no-show, fee or rain-check exception is waived or extended, then a Golf Manager approves it with a reason (and evidence where required); the requester cannot approve it
BR-048: When a golfer checks in, then it is at least 15 minutes before tee-off; later arrivals go to the late-arrival treatment

BR-049: When a golfer is released to play, then membership or guest eligibility, handicap or NSRCC PC, insurance (existing, annual or MSIG day insurance) and the 9 / 18-hole declaration are all satisfied, and the charge outcome is accepted
BR-050: When a guest claims a special rate without Guest Eligibility Proof, then the sign-in guest rate applies; proof produced within 7 working days allows an adjustment

BR-051: When a golfer is late, then they are rescheduled to a later free tee time if one exists, else joined by skipping holes if Golf Operations permits, else treated as a no-show with the no-show charge

BR-052: When a course is suspended or closed, then only the Club Captain, Vice-Captain, Golf Manager or an approved executive may do it; golfers who had not teed off get the green and buggy fee refund path, not a rain check
BR-053: When a qualifying suspension interrupts a golfer who has teed off before completing the first 9, or an 18-hole golfer who cannot cross over, then a 9-hole rain check is issued
BR-054: When a rain check is issued, then it is valid for 1 month, linked to the golfer, not transferable and has no cash value; an extension needs approval (BR-047)
BR-055: When a 9-hole rain check is applied to an 18-hole booking, then the golfer pays the top-up; a cheaper booking gives no residual refund

BR-056: When a handicap extract is imported, then it is staged and validated (identifier, gender, HI range) before it replaces the effective data; failing rows become exceptions and the prior values stay in history

BR-057: When capacity is blocked for maintenance, an HMS event, private use, a programme or management, then those tee times cannot be booked, keep their reason and source reference, and on release go to the waitlist first

BR-058: When golf charges are raised, then the rate comes from course, player category, 9 / 18 holes and day type, and every chargeable golfer has a responsible payer (member, introducing member for guests, corporate account, or self)

BR-059: When a golf charge is handed to Finance, then GMS keeps the Finance status (pending, accepted, rejected); member in-house credit needs Finance-derived eligibility (BR-023); GMS never stores a balance
BR-060: When a shift or day is closed, then counts and totals are compiled from GMS records, and unresolved exceptions and events without a Finance status stay flagged, never silently cleared

BR-061: When an event is published, then it needs no approval but every item its configuration requires (venue, schedule, sessions, capacity where controlled, rates where paid, free / paid choice) must be complete; only the Events Team may configure and publish
BR-062: When a registration is made online or at the counter, then the event or session registration window must be open (default: opens at publication, closes when the event starts)

BR-063: When a participant is registered, then they must meet the event's eligibility (who may register: members only, members and dependants, or open to non-members; age category), with member status taken from MMS (only Active members get member privileges)

BR-064: When a participant's rate is set, then it is the event rate for their qualifying category (member / non-member, adult / child); the member rate needs an Active member or responsible member; the rate and amount are frozen on the registration

BR-065: When a registration has several participants, then it is confirmed only if every participant is eligible and the whole group fits; the group is never split automatically; at most the configured participants per registration
BR-066: When capacity is checked, then confirmed places plus active holds and reserved offers may never exceed the event or session capacity

BR-067: When a paid registration goes to settlement, then the whole group's places are held (online: 15 minutes; counter: while the transaction is open); a hold is not a confirmed booking and is released on failure, abandonment or expiry

BR-068: When a registration needs payment, then it is confirmed only on a successful settlement outcome (online channel online, counter channel at the counter, or member account where Finance says the member is eligible, BR-023); a free event confirms without settlement
BR-069: When an eligible group does not fit and the waitlist is enabled, then the whole group may join the waitlist, with no payment

BR-070: When places become free, then the waitlist is read in FIFO order of join time, skipping (without losing priority) any group that does not fit in full or is no longer eligible; changing a waitlisted group's participants resets its join time
BR-071: When a waitlist place is offered, then the places stay reserved for the offer window (default 24 hours) for acceptance and payment; on expiry or failed payment they go to the next entry
BR-072: When a registration is confirmed, then each participant gets their own QR credential, linked to the registration and its sessions

BR-073: When attendance is recorded, then the credential must match a confirmed registration for that session; unmatched, cancelled or wrong-session credentials are refused, and a participant is recorded at most once per session
BR-074: When a participant cannot present a usable QR, then authorised Events staff may record attendance only against an existing confirmed registration, keeping the staff member and the reason
BR-075: When event personnel attend, then their attendance is recorded apart from participants and never uses participant capacity
BR-076: When an event misses its minimum participation, then the Events Team decides to proceed or cancel; it is never cancelled automatically

BR-077: When a participant cancels a confirmed registration, then it is classified participant-initiated, the amount paid is forfeited, the QR stops being valid and the freed places go to the waitlist
BR-078: When the club cancels an event or session, then affected registrations are cancelled; any refund or reversal, full or partial, needs Events Manager authorisation before it goes to Finance

BR-079: When the club reschedules an event or session, then confirmed participants keep their place or decline; a declining participant's refund, full or partial, needs Events Manager authorisation, and the freed places go to the waitlist

BR-080: When a function room update arrives from the Function Room Booking System, then HMS Events reflects its latest status; only a confirmed status counts as confirmed, tentative holds never do, and an update with an unknown reference changes nothing

BR-081: When a published event is changed, then a new price or eligibility rule applies only to future registrations, a cancellation goes through BR-078 and a schedule change with confirmed registrations goes through BR-079
BR-082: When capacity is reduced, then it may not go below the confirmed places plus active holds and reserved offers
BR-083: When an event's last session has ended, then the event is shown as Completed, with no manual close

BR-086: When a facility booking or admission is requested, then the customer's category (Member, SAFRA member, Non-member, Guest, Bungalow guest) and entitlement must allow that facility; member privileges apply only to an Active member (status from MMS); if the category cannot be set, no entitlement or member rate applies
BR-087: When a booking is confirmed, then the resource must be free for the whole period: no overlapping active booking on the same resource, and the customer may not hold two overlapping bookings

BR-088: When a resource is blocked (maintenance, event, lesson, operational closure) with a reason, then it cannot be booked in that period and no override is allowed; a block over an existing booking is flagged for resolution, never removing the booking silently
BR-089: When a booking is made, then its date must be inside the facility's booking window for the customer's category; same-day bookings only where the facility allows them
BR-090: When a booking is made, then its duration must fit the facility's minimum and maximum in whole slots; Billiards is 1 to 3 hours

BR-091: When a booking is priced, then the rate comes from the facility, the customer category (SAFRA rate where the facility allows SAFRA) and the day type; a public holiday is a weekend day unless a separate rate is set; the amount is frozen at confirmation

BR-092: When a booking is chargeable, then it is confirmed and gets its reference only after a successful payment; on failure or abandonment it stays unconfirmed and the slot is not reserved; a free facility confirms without payment

BR-093: When a booking is amended, then the new details pass every booking rule again and the amount is recalculated; extra amounts must be paid first; if payment fails or the new slot is gone, the original booking stays; released time inside 24 hours follows the cancellation refund rule
BR-094: When a booking is cancelled, then a reason is required and the resource is released at once (unless separately blocked)

BR-095: When a cancellation is priced, then a customer cancelling at least 24 hours before the start gets a full refund and less than 24 hours none; a club-initiated cancellation gets a full refund unless the customer accepts an alternative slot
BR-096: When a refund outside the standard policy is asked for, then it needs an Operations Manager's approval and a recorded reason before the refund instruction goes to Finance
BR-097: When a confirmed booking is recorded as a no-show, then no standard refund is due (an exceptional refund follows BR-096)

BR-098: When a customer is admitted to the Swimming Pool or Fitness Centre, then it is an admission, not a time slot: only during operating hours, within capacity, and after any admission or day-pass payment unless an entitlement covers access; attendance and occupancy are recorded

BR-099: When a customer enters the Fitness Centre, then they need an Active membership, a valid resort guest (in-house stay) (complimentary) or a valid day pass; a non-member with neither buys a day pass first
BR-100: When a day pass is issued, then it is valid for the whole operating day of issue and allows same-day re-entry; it is not valid on another day
BR-101: When a bowling counter transaction is recorded, then it needs a receipt number and is paid at the Bowling counter before play, for members and non-members alike; no member-account charging

BR-102: When a bowling export file is reconciled, then each record is matched to one CMS counter transaction by receipt number and checked on amount (tolerance S$0.00), date and payment method; unmatched, duplicate or mismatched records become exceptions; reconciled records are locked

BR-103: When a bowling exception is worked, then it stays open until Bowling Operations records a disposition and reason; an amount, payment-method, refund or void issue is escalated to Finance; it closes only as reconciled or formally accepted

BR-104: When no suitable slot is free and the facility's waiting list is enabled, then an eligible customer may join it; a freed slot is offered in FIFO order for the response window; it becomes a booking only on acceptance in time and any payment, otherwise it goes to the next entry; a request can be withdrawn before acceptance
BR-105: When facility configuration is saved, then incomplete or unapproved values are not effective for new transactions (they stay Draft), and the Billiards 1 – 3 hour limit cannot be changed

BR-106: When a Personal Training session is requested, then it is confirmed only for a participant who meets the PT eligibility policy; while the PT policy is TBC, scheduling, price and cancellation are not assumed and the session stays Pending policy where needed

BR-107 (Draft – for validation): When a resort reservation is created, then every night of the stay must have an available, eligible room (not Faulty or Maintenance Blocked, not already reserved) and the stay must be at least the minimum stay (2 consecutive nights, configured value)

BR-108 (Draft – for validation): When a member books, then the member must be Active in MMS, the arrival must be inside the category's reservation window and the stay within its maximum nights and privileges; a non-member uses the non-member window and rate
BR-109 (Draft – for validation): When a rate type is assigned by hand, then only staff may do it, from the permitted rate types
BR-110 (Draft – for validation): When a reservation is amended, then the booked guest cannot be changed: reservations are non-transferable

BR-111 (Draft – for validation): When a reservation is priced, then nightly rates by room type, day type and season apply; a Corporate member covered by a lease pays zero; Honorary members (20 %) and members flagged Committee (10 %) get their demo discount

BR-112 (Draft – for validation): When a group reservation is confirmed, then every requested room must be available; a smaller set is confirmed only when staff explicitly accept the revised set; all rooms share one master reference

BR-113 (Draft – for validation): When a reservation is placed on tentative hold, then the rooms are held for the hold period; paid in time it becomes Confirmed, otherwise it expires and the rooms are released

BR-114 (Draft – for validation): When stay dates or rooms are amended more than 21 days before arrival, then a Lost Opportunity Charge of 20 % of the original reservation value applies; at 21 days or less the amendment is processed as a cancellation

BR-115 (Draft – for validation): When a reservation is cancelled, then the charge is 50 % of the reservation value more than 21 days before arrival and 100 % at 21 days or less; the rest of the amount paid is refundable

BR-116 (Draft – for validation): When a confirmed reservation has not checked in by the no-show cutoff, then staff may process it as a no-show with a charge of 100 % of the reservation value; never before the cutoff

BR-117 (Draft – for validation): When no room is available, then the guest may join the resort waitlist; an entry never blocks inventory; when a room frees up, staff see the matching entries (oldest first) and choose one; the choice is audited and the entry closes when it becomes a reservation

BR-118 (Draft – for validation): When a payment is collected, then it counts only on a confirmed success from the payment service; every chargeable item is posted to the reservation or guest folio, and every payment, refund, adjustment and credit note is audited
BR-119 (Draft – for validation): When a resort refund is due, then it needs an Operations Manager's approval and keeps the original payment reference before the instruction goes to FIN-OPS
BR-120 (Draft – for validation): When discounts are applied, then fixed and percentage discounts apply in the configured priority, and more than one only where the combination rule allows

BR-121 (Draft – for validation): When a transaction is corrected, then an unpaid one may be adjusted and a paid one only by a credit note; both need an Operations Manager's approval and keep the original reference

BR-122 (Draft – for validation): When a guest checks in, then the reservation must be Confirmed, it must be the arrival date between 3:00 and 6:00 PM (or an approved late-arrival exception), and the room must not be Faulty, Maintenance Blocked or Pending Cleaning

BR-123 (Draft – for validation): When a room changes state, then check-in makes it Occupied and opens the folio, check-out makes it Pending Cleaning, and housekeeping makes it Ready; every room status change is audited
BR-124 (Draft – for validation): When a stay is extended or moved, then the room (or the target room) must be available for every added night
BR-125 (Draft – for validation): When a room is marked Faulty or Maintenance Blocked, then it cannot be reserved or checked in, and it returns to service only after maintenance completion is recorded

BR-126 (Draft – for validation): When a vehicle is registered to a reservation, then the registration number must be valid in the configured IU or OBU format; at most 2 vehicles per reservation, the first free and the second charged to the folio; only registered vehicles are whitelisted, for the stay period only, and revoked at check-out or cancellation

BR-127 (Draft – for validation): When an access credential is issued, then only for a Confirmed reservation and only for the stay period; a regenerated Salto PIN invalidates the previous one; check-out or cancellation deactivates it; every step is audited
BR-128 (Draft – for validation): When a guest checks out, then the folio must be settled first; check-out is due before 10:00 AM; access credentials and the vehicle whitelist are revoked
BR-129 (Draft – for validation): When a check-in or check-out is reversed, then it needs an Operations Manager's approval and a reason, restores the prior states and keeps the original event

BR-130 (Draft – for validation): When the business day is closed, then Night Audit must run first; blocking exceptions stop the close; the day's posted transactions become one Night Audit record on the FIN-OPS

BR-131 (Draft – for validation): When a financial event is raised, then it goes to FIN-OPS with its resort source reference (FIN-OPS from v07); Resorts never posts to Yonyou or holds GST, GL or receivables
BR-132 (Draft – for validation): When a reservation or operational event occurs, then a notification is generated only if that event is configured; a failed notification never undoes the transaction

BR-084: When a page opens in a tab, then it renders only if the tab's role is one the page lists; otherwise it shows no content, and every link to a page the role cannot open is plain text, not a link
BR-085: When a Member tab reads member data, then it reads only its own account (membership, requests, golf bookings, rain checks, event registrations), set once from the launcher

BR-133 (Interim design): When a financial event arrives, then it is accepted only from an approved source (MMS, GMS, HMS Events, HMS Facilities, HMS Resorts, Finance or an approved external POS file), with a source identity not seen before, and with amount, tax code and source reference present; otherwise it becomes an exception

BR-134 (Proposed): When an intake or posting error is found, then a source-data error is returned to the originating module and a mapping or Finance-treatment error stays in FIN-OPS; Finance never edits the commercial event
BR-135 (TBC): When an in-house member charge arrives without the upstream eligibility and credit check (for example while Finance is unavailable), then it is not financially completed
BR-136 (Confirmed): When an event is posted, then an active, effective, approved accounting mapping must exist for its event type; without one the posting set is blocked as Unmapped

BR-137 (Confirmed): When a posting set is generated, then every mapping leg is created in order, Output GST (9 %, the effective rate) is a separate leg on the GST-exclusive amount, and the rate and amount are kept with the event

BR-138 (Interim design): When a posting set is checked, then total debits must equal total credits; a difference up to S$0.01 from rounding is absorbed by the rounding leg, anything larger blocks it as Unbalanced

BR-139 (Interim design): When a Finance configuration item (mapping, tax rate, payment method, run schedule, refund matrix, dunning policy, GIRO fee) is changed, then it stays Draft until a second Finance user approves it, applies only from its effective date, may not overlap another active version, and a rejection keeps the current version
BR-140 (Confirmed): When a member charge is accepted, then a positive charge creates exactly one receivable line, a credit line creates none, and the same bill line never creates a second receivable

BR-141 (Interim design): When a payment is allocated, then it goes first to the bill it names, otherwise to open lines by oldest due date, then oldest transaction date; a partial amount leaves the rest open; any excess stays as unapplied credit

BR-142 (Confirmed): When money is received or returned, then a Payment is recorded with one PaymentNo as the official receipt; a reprint reuses the same PaymentNo and is audited; a Payment records the cashier, location and session
BR-143 (Interim design): When a cheque is received, then its Payment is Pending Clearance and does not count as settled for credit or dunning until cleared

BR-144 (Interim design): When a standing-order collection is created, then the order must be Active and effective on the collection date, the amount must not exceed its Maximum Debit Amount, and a membership has at most one Active order per collection type

BR-145 (Proposed): When a bank result is applied, then an accepted collection becomes a Payment; a rejected or returned one is kept with its reason, is not retried automatically, and a mandate reported invalid stops further collection
BR-146 (Interim design): When a member's second GIRO rejection falls in the same calendar month, then the configured administration fee (S$10 in the demo) is charged unless an exemption applies
BR-147 (Interim design): When a cheque is returned, then the failed Payment is kept, its allocations are released and the receivable is reopened; a Debit Note is never used to recreate the debt

BR-148 (Interim design): When spending credit is awarded, then it is a member-account credit, never a Payment or receivable; the original award stays unchanged; it is valid 24 months, and an unused balance expires through a non-cash adjustment, never a cash refund
BR-149 (Confirmed): When a security deposit is refunded, then eligible outstanding and unposted amounts are offset first, and only the remainder is refundable
BR-150 (Interim design): When an external refund is prepared, then it is released only after approval through the refund approval matrix (by type and value), and the preparer may not approve it

BR-151 (Proposed): When a refund is settled, then each part returns to its original economic source; value paid with in-house credit is restored to the member account and never paid out as cash, bank or PayNow

BR-152 (Interim design): When revenue is collected before it is earned, then it is held as deferred revenue and recognised when earned: resort stays per occupied night from HMS Resorts' stay dates, events on delivery, non-refundable charges when enforceable; no second GST

BR-153 (Interim design): When the monthly entrance-fee amortisation runs, then the entrance-fee reconciliation must show zero unexplained variance; termination or death stops future amortisation, reinstatement resumes it from the remaining balance, and posted months are never rewritten

BR-154 (Interim design): When a reconciliation is completed, then the tolerance is zero apart from up to S$0.01 rounding; timing differences are recorded as reconciling items; an unexplained variance keeps it incomplete and raises an exception
BR-155 (Confirmed): When a clearing flow is complete, then the Operations-to-Finance clearing account must be zero; a missing or duplicate counterpart or a residual is an exception

BR-156 (Interim design): When a cashier session is closed, then the system batch close compares expected collections with actual tender by payment method; a variance is an exception; cash and cleared cheques go to a bank-in batch

BR-157 (Proposed): When a Finance adjustment, reversal or void is made, then it is a separate movement linked to the original, it needs approval by a second Finance user (never self-approval), and a posting Yonyou has accepted is corrected only by reversal
BR-158 (Confirmed): When a member's credit limit is overridden, then only a user with override authority may do it, and the override is audited

BR-159 (Proposed): When a transaction is posted, then the financial year runs April – March; a prior period may be used only while it is Open; a Closed period rejects new postings unless reopened; a late item goes to the current Open period and keeps its source date

BR-160 (Interim design): When a posting batch is staged, then only posting-ready lines with no blocking exception are included, mapping, balance, GST, source-total and duplicate controls are rechecked, the batch gets a unique ID, and a transport failure retries the same batch without regenerating it

BR-161 (TBC): When the business day runs, then two scheduled posting runs (13:00 and 21:00 in the demo) and authorised ad-hoc runs are allowed; a later run never re-releases what an earlier run staged; each run reconciles on its own and the day's runs reconcile together

BR-162 (Interim design): When the Yonyou response is imported, then it is matched to the batch, accepted lines keep their ERP document number, the batch is Finalised only when everything reconciles, rejected lines become exceptions, and nothing can be resubmitted twice

BR-163 (Interim design): When a control fails, then a blocking financial exception is raised with category, owner and source; it blocks release, keeps its history, and closes only when resolved or recorded as a reconciling item

BR-164 (Interim design): When dunning is evaluated, then the eligible overdue balance (positive unpaid amounts after payments, credits and adjustments) and its age set the stage under the active policy: Reminder 1 at 30 days, Reminder 2 at 60, Final notice at 90, Escalated at 120; a partial payment re-evaluates, full clearance closes, a hold with a reason pauses
BR-165 (Interim design): When a dunning stage needs a membership action, then FIN-OPS creates an escalation to MMS; it never suspends or changes a membership itself

BR-166 (Interim design): When a General AR invoice is created, then the debtor must be Active, the use case must be Finance-originated (not a module transaction), every line must map to an approved product and tax code, a second Finance user approves it, and once issued it is never edited

BR-167 (Interim design): When an issued document is corrected, then a Credit Note (full or partial, with reason, approval and the original tax rate) or a Debit Note (an approved extra charge) is linked to it; an operational bill gets a Finance Credit Note only with an exception reason
BR-168 (Interim design): When a recurring arrangement's billing date comes, then the invoice is generated with the same controls as a manual one; a change applies only to future invoices
BR-169 (Interim design): When a General Debtor is aged, then ageing uses the due date, overdue items follow the GENERAL_DEBTOR dunning profile, and interest is not charged unless a policy enables it

BR-170 (Interim design): When a receipt, invoice, credit note, debit note or statement is reprinted, then no new financial evidence is created, the original reference is kept and the reprint is audited
BR-171: When an application or profile is saved, then the email must be a valid address and the mobile a Singapore number (+65, 8 digits, starting 8 or 9)
BR-172: When dates are entered, then the date of birth is not in the future, and a period's end date is after its start date
BR-173: When the first fee of a new or rejoining membership is confirmed paid in a month, then the membership starts on the 1st of the next month
BR-174: When a membership starts or is renewed, then its expiry = start date + the type's term in months (from configuration), moved out by approved absent months (BR-016)
BR-175: When a request is Submitted, then it is read-only until it is returned for correction or decided; only a Draft or Pending Documents request can be edited
BR-176: When a request is rejected or returned, then a reason is required

BR-177: When a material action happens (create, submit, decide, pay, apply, status change, configuration change), then a history entry records actor, role, time, from and to status, and comment; entries are never edited or deleted
BR-178 (retired in v07, Story-202): the Finance stub is replaced by FIN-OPS; a fee is confirmed by a FIN-OPS Payment and a failure is a rejected attempt

Club Reporting: the 10 Finance reports FIN-OPS-RR-002 … 017 in the Report Catalogue, exportable

Every module money step (Membership fees, refunds and clearance; golf charges; event payments and refunds; facility payments and refunds; resort deposits, payments, corrections, refunds and the Night Audit day) raises a FIN-OPS event instead of the Finance stub
Launcher: all seven modules live, the Finance tab in Module details, the Finance Officer and Finance Approver roles
Membership, Club Reporting, Golf, Events, Facilities and Resorts of v01 to v06, kept except where they connect to Finance
out: Real Yonyou, bank, payment-provider and POS links (simulated); interest and late-payment charges (off); the 9 FIN-OPS reports covered by screens; statement suppression, the corporate entrance-fee variant, GST rate-change rebilling
Real authentication, real e-mail and SMS, and any server, API or database

constraints: FIN-OPS never changes a membership or a module's commercial record: it returns status and raises Membership escalations
Maker and checker are always two people for refunds, configuration, adjustments, invoices, notes and overrides
A Payment is only real money; in-house credit is never paid out as cash
Interim Design and TBC rules are demo values, labelled on the page that uses them
Finance runs on the fixed demo clock (Wed 28 Oct 2026 11:55, period P07); posting runs start from buttons
Historical records are never physically deleted; a posted month is never rewritten
Static site opened from file://, browser storage, invented data, Bootstrap 5.3.3 as the only library
